title: Reconcile stale backlog/implementation-ready language in docs/scenarios/evolution/README.md with its own OBSOLETE banner
rule: Tier-4 triage AREA NOTE — internal doc self-consistency for a point-in-time artifact

evidence.quote: > Use these docs as the implementation-ready spec when Epic 22 work starts.

why: Line 1 says the design is obsolete and not being implemented, but the frontmatter (line 9) still claims `status: backlog` and line 22 tells the reader to treat the set as 'implementation-ready ... when Epic 22 work starts' — implying a future implementation that docs/linear-status.md confirms will not happen (Epic 22/DNI-255: all 22 stories Canceled). Risk is low only because the unambiguous top banner reads first; a reader skimming past line 1 into the frontmatter or body could still conclude Epic 22 is merely queued rather than abandoned.
recommendation: Delete or rewrite the frontmatter `status: backlog` field and the line-22 'implementation-ready spec... when Epic 22 work starts' sentence so the whole file agrees with its own line-1 OBSOLETE/superseded banner.
acceptance_criteria: docs/scenarios/evolution/README.md contains no `status: backlog` or 'when Epic 22 work starts' language.
The file's frontmatter and body both agree with its own line-1 OBSOLETE/superseded banner.
